title: GRONI death-index profile match audit
source_description: User-supplied transcription of 152 unique Glasgow surname death-index entries; paid certificates not consulted.
method: Exact death-date search without a birth-year constraint, followed by forename/variant and age-derived birth-range/locality searches against local and live public WikiTree profiles, including profiles with blank/partial deaths. Cross-reference supplied birth and marriage indexes; review candidate biographies and contradictions before assigning identities.
limitations: Registration district does not prove exact death place or birthplace. Age-derived birth year is approximate. Public WikiTree searches cannot resolve private profiles. No suitable public fit is not by itself a distinct-person determination for profile creation. Robert entries are assigned elsewhere; paid certificates were not viewed.

birth_crosswalk.note: A single candidate in the supplied birth list is a lead, not proof; multiple candidates are held.

marriage_crosswalk.note: Marriage summary lacks given names of non-Glasgow spouses, parents and residence; same-forename, same-district overlap is only a lead.

live_duplicate_search: Completed: 75 live name/birth-range/death queries, 13 broader variant checks and 80 exact-death-date/name queries using the documented searchPerson action and appId. Zero API errors or rate-limit responses. One additional confirmed profile (Cushnehan-1), two additional possible profiles (Glasgow-1422, Unknown-766238). Earlier Limit exceeded/unknown_action report came from invalid API usage.

family_crosswalk.note: A same-district marriage surname matching a birth mother maiden surname suggests a family cluster but does not prove individual parentage. Births after death were excluded.
